capabilities: Receive email via IMAP and save each message as a Markdown note with frontmatter
Compose and send email via SMTP with drafts, signatures and attachments
Manage multiple accounts with passwords stored in the Obsidian Keychain
Render HTML email safely with scoped CSS or convert it to Markdown
Reply, forward, and mark messages as read, unread or spam
extras: README is mostly in Chinese; detailed documentation lives in separate repo files (docs/design.md, docs/USER_MANUAL.md, docs/ANALYSIS.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md). Desktop-only (requires Obsidian >= 1.11.4). Install is currently manual from a GitHub release; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Common providers require an app-specific authorization code rather than the login password.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to receive, send or archive email, so messages live outside the vault and can't be searched or linked like notes.

relations.evidence: a classic Foxmail-style three-pane mail view (folder tree / message list / reading pane)

summary: Email client that sends and receives mail over IMAP/SMTP and stores every message as a searchable Markdown note with frontmatter.
